name: Campaigner
description_en:
Campaigner is a product in the Email marketing category. Its directory profile covers Abandoned Cart Email, Mobile App, Delivery by Time Zone, Send Time Optimization, Sign Up Forms, Predesigned Email Templates, Email Scheduling, Contact List Import.

Additional listed capabilities include Real-time Email Editor, Document Library, List Segmentation, Drag and Drop Editor, A/B Testing, Template Management, Spam Check, Mailing List Management. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $14.00. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: compare variants using a defined outcome measure; organize and reuse predefined structures; store and organize people, organizations and their contact details. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
